title: Workshop commissions: scribes and alchemists
summary: Order spell scrolls and potions from NPC scribes and alchemists, made over downtime and collected at their workshop.
items: The DM sets up a scribe or alchemist with ready-made prices from the free D&D rules (SRD 5.2.1 or SRD 5.1) or their own.
Talk to them and choose Services · Workshop: pick the scroll or brew and how many, and bring your own healing herbs to pay less.
You pay once when you order. Work only moves forward when the DM approves downtime.
The Downtime screen shows blacksmith and workshop work together under Commissions.
When it's ready, go back to the workshop and collect it; Market's Service commission register tracks your orders while you travel.
The DM can pause, resume or cancel an order with a reason.
